original_prompt.prompt: Create a compelling product description for a new eco-friendly water bottle. Highlight its sustainable features and unique selling points.

clarity.description: Evaluation of prompt clarity and specificity
suggestions: Add specific details about sustainable features

structure.description: Assessment of reasoning flow and organization
suggestions: Improve logical flow to guide the description better
Consider using bullet points for organization
Specify the desired length of the description
Provide more detailed guidance on features

enhanced_prompt.prompt: Create a compelling product description for a new eco-friendly water bottle aimed at environmentally conscious consumers. Highlight its sustainable features, such as materials used, energy efficiency in production, and durability, as well as its unique selling points like design, usability, and any certifications (e.g., BPA-free). The description should be engaging and inspiring, ideally between 100-150 words. Use bullet points for features if necessary.
